A rushed vote stops a controversial abortion bill in South Australia, sparking debate over conscience and consultation.

Sarah Game’s late-term abortion bill has failed
Evidence: protect fetuses, legislative defeat, healthcare access
#Aletheia #AusPol

The democratic process functioned via a conscience vote to uphold established healthcare laws.
South Australia's lower house voted 36 to 9 against Sarah Game's bill, which sought to restrict abortion access after 25 weeks.
